nights.title: Niall Horan: Dinner Party Live On Tour
nights.name: Niall Horan
nights.extract: Niall James Horan is an Irish singer, songwriter, musician, and multi-instrumentalist. He rose to prominence as a member of the boy band One Direction, formed in 2010 on the singing competition The X Factor. The group released five albums and went on to become one of the best-selling boy bands of all time.

facts: One Direction was formed in 2010 on the singing competition The X Factor.
The group released five albums and went on to become one of the best-selling boy bands of all time.

de.who: Niall James Horan ist ein irischer Sänger, Songwriter, Musiker und Multiinstrumentalist. Bekannt wurde er als Mitglied der Boyband One Direction.
facts: One Direction wurde 2010 in der Gesangsshow The X Factor gegründet.
Die Gruppe veröffentlichte fünf Alben und zählt zu den meistverkauften Boybands aller Zeiten.

tr.kicker: irlandalı şarkıcı, söz yazarı ve müzisyen
tr.who: Niall James Horan, bir İrlandalı şarkıcı, söz yazarı, müzisyen ve çok enstrümanlı sanatçıdır. Boy grubu One Direction'ın üyesi olarak ün kazandı.
facts: One Direction, 2010 yılında The X Factor adlı yetenek yarışmasında kuruldu.
Grup beş albüm yayımladı ve tüm zamanların en çok satan boy gruplarından biri oldu.

nights.title: Wolves in the Throne Room
nights.name: Wolves in the Throne Room
nights.extract: Wolves in the Throne Room is an American black metal band formed in 2002 in Olympia, Washington, by brothers Aaron and Nathan Weaver. They have released seven full-length albums, two live albums, and two EPs to date. They have stated one of the founding concepts of the band to be channeling the "energies of the Pacific Northwest's landscape" into musical form.

en.who: Wolves in the Throne Room is an American black metal band formed in 2002 in Olympia, Washington, by brothers Aaron and Nathan Weaver. They have released seven full-length albums, two live albums, and two EPs to date.
facts: They have stated one of the founding concepts of the band to be channeling the "energies of the Pacific Northwest's landscape" into musical form.
They have released two live albums and two EPs to date.

de.who: Wolves in the Throne Room ist eine amerikanische Black-Metal-Band, die 2002 in Olympia, Washington, von den Brüdern Aaron und Nathan Weaver gegründet wurde. Bis heute veröffentlichten sie sieben Alben in voller Länge, zwei Livealben und zwei EPs.
facts: Ein Gründungskonzept der Band war es laut eigener Aussage, die „Energien der Landschaft des Pazifischen Nordwestens“ in Musik zu übersetzen.
Zu ihren Veröffentlichungen gehören zwei Livealben und zwei EPs.

tr.who: Wolves in the Throne Room, 2002 yılında Olympia, Washington'da kardeşler Aaron ve Nathan Weaver tarafından kurulmuş bir Amerikalı black metal grubudur. Bugüne kadar yedi tam uzunluklu albüm, iki canlı albüm ve iki EP yayımladılar.
facts: Grubun kurucu kavramlarından biri, "Pasifik Kuzeybatısı'nın manzarasının enerjilerini" müziğe aktarmaktı.
Yayın listelerinde iki canlı albüm ve iki EP yer alıyor.

nights.title: Airbag
nights.name: Airbag
nights.extract: Airbag is an Argentine hard rock band formed in Buenos Aires in 1999, consisting of three brothers: Patricio Sardelli, Gastón Sardelli, and Guido Sardelli. They have released eight studio albums and two live albums, and tour mostly around Latin America.

nights.title: Kamelot
nights.name: Kamelot
nights.extract: Kamelot is an American power metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed by Thomas Youngblood in 1987. The Norwegian vocalist Roy Khan joined for the album Siége Perilous, and shared songwriting credit with Youngblood until his departure in April 2011. On June 22, 2012, Youngblood announced on their website that their new vocalist would be the Swedish singer Tommy Karevik, who was first featured on Kamelot's album Silverthorn as the main vocalist, co-songwriter, and lyricist.

en.who: Kamelot is an American power metal band from Tampa, Florida, formed by Thomas Youngblood in 1987. The Norwegian vocalist Roy Khan joined for the album Siége Perilous, and shared songwriting credit with Youngblood until his departure in April 2011.
facts: On June 22, 2012, Youngblood announced on their website that their new vocalist would be the Swedish singer Tommy Karevik.
Tommy Karevik was first featured on Kamelot's album Silverthorn as the main vocalist, co-songwriter, and lyricist.

facts: Am 22. Juni 2012 gab Youngblood auf der Website der Band bekannt, dass der schwedische Sänger Tommy Karevik ihr neuer Sänger wird.
Karevik war zuvor auf dem Album Silverthorn als Hauptsänger, Co-Songwriter und Texter zu hören.

tr.who: Kamelot, 1987 yılında Thomas Youngblood tarafından kurulan, Florida'nın Tampa kentinden bir Amerikalı power metal grubudur. Norveçli vokalist Roy Khan, Siége Perilous albümü için gruba katıldı ve Nisan 2011'deki ayrılışına kadar Youngblood ile şarkı yazarlığı payını paylaştı.
facts: 22 Haziran 2012'de Youngblood, grubun web sitesinde yeni vokalistinin İsveçli şarkıcı Tommy Karevik olacağını duyurdu.
Karevik, daha önce Silverthorn albümünde ana vokalist, ortak söz yazarı ve sözcü olarak yer almıştı.

nights.title: KoRn
nights.name: Korn
nights.extract: Korn is an American nu metal band from Bakersfield, California, originally formed in 1993 by James "Munky" Shaffer, Reginald "Fieldy" Arvizu, and David Silveria, who were members of the band L.A.P.D. Their current lineup features Shaffer (guitar), Brian "Head" Welch (guitar), Jonathan Davis (vocals), and Ray Luzier (drums), the last of whom replaced Silveria in 2007. The band is notable for pioneering and popularizing the nu metal genre.

en.who: Korn is an American nu metal band from Bakersfield, California, originally formed in 1993 by James "Munky" Shaffer, Reginald "Fieldy" Arvizu, and David Silveria. The band is notable for pioneering and popularizing the nu metal genre.
facts: Their current lineup features Shaffer (guitar), Brian "Head" Welch (guitar), Jonathan Davis (vocals), and Ray Luzier (drums).

facts: Die aktuelle Besetzung umfasst Shaffer (Gitarre), Brian „Head“ Welch (Gitarre), Jonathan Davis (Gesang) und Ray Luzier (Schlagzeug).
Ray Luzier ersetzte 2007 David Silveria.

nights.title: Napalm Death | Support: Master, Brat, Goatburner
nights.name: Napalm Death
nights.extract: Napalm Death are an English grindcore band formed in Meriden, West Midlands, in 1981. The band currently consists of Barney Greenway on vocals, Shane Embury on bass guitar, John Cooke on guitar and Danny Herrera on drums. None of the founding band members remain in the band. From 1989 to 2004, Napalm Death were a five-piece band after they added Jesse Pintado and Mitch Harris as replacements for guitarist Bill Steer. Following Pintado's departure, the band reverted to a four-piece. Mitch Harris left the band in 2014 to focus on his personal life. Since Mitch's indefinite hiatus, guitarist John Cooke can be seen on guitar during live shows.

Mitch Harris left the band in 2014 to focus on his personal life.

facts: Keines der ursprünglichen Gründungsmitglieder ist noch in der Band.

facts: Kurucu üyelerinin hiçbiri artık grupta değil.
Mitch Harris, kişisel hayatına odaklanmak için 2014 yılında gruptan ayrıldı.
